selection_reasoning: These two tasks form a coherent multi-hop sequence centered on finding and interacting with redstone components in a built environment. The player must first locate a birch_pressure_plate, which serves as a landmark/clue indicating the area where redstone components are placed. The dark_oak_button is positioned nearby but requires the player to first identify the correct area by finding the pressure plate. This creates a natural exploration-then-action dependency: find the pressure plate area first, then mine the button that is in the same redstone component zone. Both tasks are observable and verifiable — one requires proximity/visual confirmation, the other requires breaking a block and collecting it.

edges.reason: The birch_pressure_plate marks the redstone component area where the dark_oak_button is located; finding it first guides the player to the button's location

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close enough to the birch pressure plate (at spawn-relative 6, 0, 4) and face toward it to confirm visual identification. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at it.

Uses inventory_has because mining a dark oak button drops it as an item into the player's inventory. Dark oak buttons can be broken instantly by hand (no tool required) and always drop themselves. The player starts with no dark_oak_button in inventory, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining.

scene_description: A small stone brick building with a dark oak button on its south wall (above the entrance), with a birch pressure plate placed on the ground approach path. A lantern and stone slab mark the path. A small oak shelter with crafting table serves as a secondary landmark. The player first finds the birch pressure plate on the ground (marking the area), then proceeds to the stone structure to locate and mine the dark oak button from the wall.
task_text: Find the birch pressure plate on the ground near the stone brick building, then mine the dark oak button from the building's south wall.
design_notes: Layout: Player spawns at origin facing south. Birch pressure plate at ~6 ~0 ~4 is on the ground approach path to the stone building. Lantern at ~6 ~0 ~2 serves as a beacon. Stone brick building spans ~4,~6 to ~8,~10 with entrance on south face (z=6). Dark oak button at ~6 ~1 ~6 on the south wall above the doorway (facing south so it's visible from approach). Oak shelter at ~-2 to ~0, z=8-10 with crafting table. Stone slab at ~3 ~0 ~4 marks the path. The player naturally walks toward the building, encounters the pressure plate first, then reaches the button.
